title: Same game shows 85.3% win chance in the pick card but 74% in the chart caption and bucket table
steps: Compare WIN % (85.3%) with chart caption "wins (74% of runs)" and sum of "yes" buckets (~73.9%)
expected: One win probability everywhere on the page
actual: Top card 85.3%; chart says 74%. Same on CBB Saint Mary's: 71.1% vs 74%. A casual reader cannot tell which is true.
suspected_area: sim histogram vs fair prob (suspected: chart uses simulation, card uses market consensus)
